all_quotes.quote: We present the survey design and initial results of the ALMA Cycle 9 program of DUALZ, which aims to establish a joint ALMA and *JWST* public legacy field targeting the massive galaxy cluster Abell 2744.
Abell 2744 (A2744), at $z=0.308$, is one of the best-studied massive galaxy clusters and is the target of our survey.

we present the Deep UNCOVER-ALMA Legacy High-$z$ (DUALZ) Survey, specifically designed to establish Abell 2744 (A2744), one of the best-studied massive galaxy lensing clusters, as a joint ALMA and *JWST* legacy field.
